result.summary: Found 1 issue: overlapping text in the restaurant metadata row under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', where the delivery time and delivery fee strings collide and become unreadable.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping text: '25–30 min' and '€0 delivery' are rendered on top of each other (appearing as garbled text like '25–3€0 delivery'), making both the delivery time and the delivery fee unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery-time and delivery-fee labels are laid out as separate, non-overlapping elements (e.g., flex row with a separator dot and proper spacing/truncation) so each string renders on its own without collision.
